name: Winfrey Hollow
source:
A narrative game about a young man, a strange inheritance, and a town where cozy streets hide intrigue, temptation, experiments, and a door to another world.

[From [url=https://nikorastudio.net/]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
一部关于年轻男子、一笔蹊跷遗产，以及一座在温馨街巷之下掩藏着阴谋诡计、致命诱惑、秘密实验与异世界之门的小镇的叙事游戏。

[摘自[url=https://nikorastudio.net/]官方网站[/url]]
